notes: Controller, keyboard and mouse feel. All values are design choices exposed in Settings; C-arm motion limits and speeds come from data/imaging/imaging.json.

deadZone.note: Radial dead zone on each stick.

responseExponent.note: Output = sign(x) * |x|^n after the dead zone; 1 = linear.

triggerThreshold.note: Digital threshold for trigger actions such as fluoro.

deadZone.note: Stick dead zones a learner can choose in Settings; a saved value outside this range falls back to the default. Added at the M1 gate.

deadZoneStep.note: Settings slider step for the dead zone. Added at the M1 gate.

responseExponent.note: Response-curve exponents a learner can choose in Settings (1 is linear); a saved value outside this range falls back to the default. Added at the M1 gate.

responseExponentStep.note: Settings slider step for the response exponent. Added at the M1 gate.

rumbleStrengthStep.note: Settings slider step for the rumble strength, which runs from 0 to 1 like the actuator's magnitudes. Added at the M1 gate.

advanceSpeedMax.note: Full-stick advance or retract speed for catheters and wires.

rotationSpeedMax.note: Full-stick rotation speed (one turn per second).

fineScale.note: Speed multiplier in fine mode (L3 or Shift).

quarterTurnStep.note: Rotation per tap in the optional torque-device mode.

dragCarmPerPixel.note: C-arm rotation or angulation per pixel of drag in Control mode.

dragTablePerPixel.note: Table pan per pixel of right-drag in Control mode.

collimationMin.note: Narrowest collimation as a fraction of the field of view.

savedViews.note: Saved C-arm angles (A in Control mode).

updateRate.note: Maximum playEffect calls per second (each call overrides the last).

contactFullScaleForce.note: Tip normal force that maps to full weak-motor rumble.

events.note: Fires when hub force crosses feedback.hubForceDanger.

strengthDefault.note: Default rumble strength multiplier in Settings.

takeoverThreshold.note: Any live stick deflection above this, or any button, hands control back from the autopilot.

advanceSpeed.note: Insertion speed of the sandbox-c-left and sandbox-b-bend demos, the speed of the golden scenes; sandbox-a-buckle uses its own pushSpeed. Added in M1 phase C (docs/M1-plan.md D4).

rotateSpeed.note: Hub rotation speed of the demos while they turn a tip toward a branch. Added in M1 phase C (docs/M1-plan.md D4).

settings.text: The autopilot always maps through the default dead zone and response exponent in this file, with no inversion or mirroring, so demos and replays do not depend on the learner's settings.
